Treat as camp/training facility rather than a general public gym unless confirmed.

coverageNotes: SEARCH BUDGET EXHAUSTED: the shared WebSearch budget for this run was already used up before this agent's first call, so all 4 attempted searches (gym in Eldoret; Eldoret gym membership fitness centre contact; gym in Kitale Trans Nzoia; gym in Kericho fitness centre) returned nothing and no search was performed. The queries array is therefore empty. No new venues were discovered, because venue discovery depends on search and I did not recall venues from memory or query search engines another way. What was done: read the seed for the region (about 15 relevant entries: Eldoret 8, Iten 4, Kitale 1, Kericho 1 apparently misplaced Biofit entry at lng 37.02) and opened seed-linked and venue-linked pages with WebFetch. Results: CrossFit 254 (Eldoret) gained a street address and phone from the CrossFit affiliate page; Zoezi at Boma Inn Eldoret gained address, phones and hours from the hotel's own pages; HATC Iten gained address, email and facility detail but no phone and uncertain activity. Seed websites that did not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND, not proof of closure): fitnessforlifecenter.com (Fitness For Life Center, Eldoret), alpha-supplement.com (Alpha Supplements, Eldoret), biofitphysio.co.ke (Biofit rehabilitation clinic, listed under Kericho). Not checked at all for lack of search: Billy's Fitness Depot, Heralds lifestyle and wellness centre, raukafitness, Gym Eagle Fitness Center (Eldoret area); Avenidus Fitness Centre (Kitale, OSM); Kapsait Nike Athletics Camp, Lorna Kiplagat stadium and World Class Gym (Elgeyo-Marakwet). Counties with zero coverage this round: Trans Nzoia (beyond the Kitale seed entry), Nandi/Kapsabet, Kericho, Bomet, West Pokot/Kapenguria, Turkana/Lodwar, Samburu/Maralal. Whether these have gyms with an online presence is unknown, not established as none. Recommendation: rerun this group with a fresh search budget (or a raised CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION) using the planned query set, in extended mode for Kitale, Kericho, Kapsabet, Lodwar and Maralal.
